scenarios.name: health-log
scenarios.unsupportedReason: the Health & Event Log dialog is live process telemetry — server pid, RSS/heap, uptime and a connection-event list whose length and order follow the browser's reconnects — so it cannot be made pixel-stable without masking most of it (the fake engine's warnings are not in it either: WARNINGS LOGGED stays 0)

scenarios.name: question-pending
scenarios.unsupportedReason: the fake engine has no question step: it can only emit approval_request, never question_request (engines/fake-engine.mjs step list); an AskUserQuestion approval renders as a suppressed tool, not a QuestionCard

scenarios.name: rate-limit
scenarios.unsupportedReason: no fake-engine step emits `rate_limit` (only Claude's rate_limit_event / Codex usage-limit adapters do), so neither the limit banner nor the resume-choice state can be reached

scenarios.name: model-fallback
scenarios.unsupportedReason: no fake-engine step emits `model_fallback` (only the Claude system/model_fallback adapter does)

scenarios.name: wrap-up
scenarios.unsupportedReason: the Wrap-Up Allowance is the `grace` field of a `rate_limit` event, which the fake engine cannot emit

scenarios.name: streaming-text-caret
scenarios.unsupportedReason: the fake `message` step emits started+delta+completed back-to-back, so a message block that is still receiving deltas (the live text caret) cannot be frozen; `streaming` shows a frozen turn with an open tool call instead

pathPlaceholders: `{name}` in a path is the id of the session seeded for that scenario (random per run)

masks.target: any text node containing a seeded session id
masks.replacement: sess-XXXXXXXXX padded with X to the id's 14 chars
masks.reason: session ids are random per run and appear verbatim in handoff briefs
the live activity verb is picked by hashing the random turn id (lib/spinner-words.mjs)

removedElements.reason: Next.js dev-mode overlay (the "N · Issues" badge); the harness runs `next dev`, and the overlay is not part of the app

determinism.browserClock: Playwright clock.setFixedTime(<phase start> + 600500 ms); timezone UTC, locale en-US, colorScheme light, reducedMotion reduce
determinism.serverClock: scripts/parity-clock.mjs: phase k starts at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z + k h + k·100 ms, runs at 0.001x real time, and steps +60 s (SIGUSR2) before every seeded session, so sessions never share a timestamp
determinism.screenshot: animations: disabled, caret: hide, retaken until two consecutive captures are identical
determinism.waits: each session shot waits for the page's own session-controls and server-settings replies (observed by an in-page WebSocket message listener); when next dev's StrictMode double-connect dropped the app's one-shot server-settings request, the harness re-sends that same ClientMessage on the app's open /ws socket
